name: plastic_orbs_gemini
source: plastic_orbs_gemini, authored as 9 control points as the albedo of the plastic_orbs style from gemini-25.jpg: a near-black plum ground through maroon and rust (the reference's lower deciles) into tan and a warm cream for the satin webs, each stop a little more saturated than the reference's means and its top below them, since the lights supply the near-whites; the blue orbs are the stack's literal paint.
